summary: Settlers stoned a Palestinian vehicle; NAD names Muhammad Sami Muhammad Abu Rabi' as injured and taken to a Nablus hospital.
discovery_sources: PLO Negotiations Affairs Department daily report for Mar. 26-27; NAD March 2023 monthly report; OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; renewed Arabic/English event-level searches
resolution_notes: Unresolved-first recheck strengthened the source/date mapping but still does not support a safe standalone acceptance. NAD's daily report logs the event in its Mar. 26 08:00-Mar. 27 08:00 reporting window and gives a Mar. 27 timestamp; NAD's monthly report dates the same named incident Mar. 26. OCHA separately reports one of two vehicle-stoning injuries on Mar. 27 on roads near Nablus/Ramallah but does not name the victim/location. No independent exact-event source was recovered. Preserve the date discrepancy and keep Unresolved rather than create a potentially duplicate or overclaimed incident.
media_status: No exact incident media recovered; no substitute imagery used.
